messages:
maria: quick heads-up — after merging the Sylph LoRA (v2.1) into base-sparrow-7b-int4 the invoice quick-eval shows a big factual regression and hallucinations on date/amount fields. throwing this into triage.

ashok: paste the eval summary?

maria: run snippet:
```
./run_eval --model base-sparrow-7b-int4+Sylph-v2.1 --dataset invoices-qa --metrics exact_match,f1
results: exact_match 0.63  (baseline 0.89)
example fail: Q: \"What is the total due?\" -> A: \"August 12\" (hallucinated date)
```

jess: that's a large drop. any tokenizer changes in the LoRA finetune?

maria: author says vocab unchanged, but they added a special marker <INV_START> in training. vocab size matches, token id appended at end.

lenore: how does this look in fp16 and int8? maybe quant interacts poorly with the merged weights.

maria: fp16+merged EM ~0.88, int8 ~0.86, int4+merged -> 0.63. interestingly LoRA-only (no merge) on int4 gives 0.87. so the failure is specifically merge+int4.

ci-bot: artifact created: sylph-v2.1-lora-merge-2026-03-21

ashok: triage plan: 1) run lora-only inference (no merge) 2) merged float32 run 3) dump per-layer KV diffs 4) check merge tool quant clamps / per-head scaling 5) repro on different kernel backends

maria: did lora-only: EM 0.87. merged float32: 0.86. merged+int4: 0.63. kv-dump in progress.

jess: can you collect single-token softmax logits for a failing prompt across variants; that usually points to where distributions flip.

maria: sample logits (trimmed):
```
input: \"Total due: ?\"
float32-merged top: {"$": 12.4, "date": 9.1, "August": 3.2}
int4-merged top:   {"August": 11.8, "$": 7.0, "12": 2.1}
```

ashok: looks like an attention/head-scale shift after quantization — token ranking flips. suspect merge quant rounding or clamp step.

lenore: i'll repro on triton kernels + cublas fallback to see if kernel numerics differ. assign to infra.

jess: i'll grep the merge script for recent scale/clamp changes (PRs in last 2 weeks).

maria: uploaded artifacts and KV diffs: https://redwood.internal/runs/3112223334/artifacts (contains example traces and dumps)

ashok: found change in merge tool: PR #7421 introduced a per-head clamp during int4 packing. reverting that locally and re-running.

maria: patched merge + int4 quick run -> EM 0.85 (much improved, not fully baseline). kicking off full quickpack overnight.

ci-bot: nightly-eval scheduled for 2026-03-22T03:00Z

jess: if nightly still shows regression, we'll block this LoRA merge and create a short postmortem.

maria: will update thread with final numbers tomorrow. :thumbsup:
